records.explanation: Variant B converts at 44.4% against 39.7% for A, a gap of 4.8 points, and a two-proportion z-test gives z ≈ 7.4. That is well above the 1.96 cutoff for 95% significance.
records.sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT ed.variant, SUM(ed.taps)::float8 AS taps, SUM(ed.installs)::float8 AS installs
  FROM reporting.experiment_daily ed
  JOIN reporting.experiments e ON e.experiment_id = ed.experiment_id
  WHERE e.experiment_name = 'Product page: new screenshots'
    AND ed.variant IN ('A','B')
  GROUP BY ed.variant
), ab AS (
  SELECT a.installs AS xa, a.taps AS na, b.installs AS xb, b.taps AS nb
  FROM agg a, agg b
  WHERE a.variant = 'A' AND b.variant = 'B'
), z AS (
  SELECT xa, na, xb, nb,
         xa/na AS cr_a, xb/nb AS cr_b,
         (xa+xb)/(na+nb) AS p,
         (xb/nb - xa/na) AS diff
  FROM ab
)
SELECT cr_a, cr_b, diff,
       diff / SQRT(p*(1-p)*(1/na + 1/nb)) AS z_score,
       CASE WHEN ABS(diff / SQRT(p*(1-p)*(1/na + 1/nb))) > 1.96 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS significant_95
FROM z

WITH v AS (
  SELECT d.variant, SUM(d.taps)::numeric AS taps, SUM(d.installs)::numeric AS installs
  FROM reporting.experiment_daily d
  JOIN reporting.experiments e ON e.experiment_id = d.experiment_id
  WHERE e.experiment_name = 'Product page: shorter subtitle'
    AND d.variant IN ('A','B')
  GROUP BY d.variant
), p AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant='A' THEN taps END) AS n_a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant='A' THEN installs END) AS x_a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant='B' THEN taps END) AS n_b,
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant='B' THEN installs END) AS x_b
  FROM v
), z AS (
  SELECT *,
    (x_b/n_b - x_a/n_a) AS diff,
    ((x_a+x_b)/(n_a+n_b)) AS pooled
  FROM p
)
SELECT x_a/n_a AS cr_a, x_b/n_b AS cr_b,
       diff / sqrt(pooled*(1-pooled)*(1/n_a + 1/n_b)) AS z_score,
       CASE WHEN abs(diff / sqrt(pooled*(1-pooled)*(1/n_a + 1/n_b))) > 1.96 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS significant_95
FROM z
